sla_onsite.text: jetje konkretnih tehničnih, organizacijskih in kadrovskih ukrepov, ustreznih za preprečitev nadaljnjih kaznivih dejanj ali kršitev. Pri ocenjevanju ukrepov, ki jih sprejme gospodarski subjekt, naročnik upošteva resnost in posebne okoliščine kaznivega dejanja ali kršitve. Če naročnik oceni, da dokazi, ki jih je predložil gospodarski subjekt, zadoščajo, gospodarskega subjekta ne glede na Odprti postopek oddaje javnega naročila: Najem in vzdrževanje sistemske programske opreme verzija 6 Stran 11 od 48 razloge za izključitev ne izključi iz postopka javnega naročanja. turnover_financial.text: äten benötigt werden, auch selbst erbringt (und insofern gleichzeitig ein Unterauftragnehmer ist). Bei einem Unterauftrag überträgt der Bieter die Ausführung eines wesentlichen Teils des Auftrags auf einen Dritten, ohne dass es sich dabei jedoch zwingend um einen Fall der Eignungsleihe handeln muss, z.B. wenn der Bieter selbst die Eignung für die Erbringung einer Leistung besitzt und sich trotz- dem eines Unterauftragnehmers bedient (bloße Unterauftragsvergabe). Zu den in den jeweiligen Konstellationen geforderten Angaben und Unterlagen: a) Eignungsleihe: Sofern der Bieter (bzw. die Bietergemeinschaft) im Hinblick auf die erforderliche wirtschaftliche und finanzielle sowie die technische und berufliche Leistungsfähigkeit beabsichtigt, die Kapazitäten ande- rer Unternehmen in Anspruch zu nehmen (Eignungsleihe), hat er mit dem Angebot im Verzeichnis der Drittunternehmen unter Ziffer 2 des Angebotsschreibens (Anlage V4) folgende Angaben zu machen: • Angabe der Kapazitäten, auf die sich bei der Eignungsprüfung berufen werden soll. • Namentliche Benennung der Unternehmen, auf deren Kapazitäten sich bei der Eignungsprü- fung berufen werden soll. Aufforderung zur Abgabe von Angeboten 26-09149 PostgreSQL DB Service Seite 7 von 17 Außerdem sind ebenfalls mit dem Angebot die folgenden Unterlagen einzureichen: • Verpflichtungserklärung (Anlage E3) je Eignungsleihgeber. Das Dokument ist in Textform auszufüllen und durch den Bieter (bzw. den Vertreter der Bie- tergemeinschaft) einzureichen. • Eignungsnachweise je Eignungsleihgeber (vgl. Ziffer 6) in Bezug auf die Kapazitäten des Eig- nungsleihgebers, auf die sich der Bieter zum Nachweis seiner Eignung beruft. b) Bloße Unterauftragsvergabe: Sofern der Bieter (bzw. die Bietergemeinschaft) beabsichtigt, Unterauftragnehmer für wesentlic

1. Introduction

The African Union Development Agency – New Partnership for Africa Development (AUDA-NEPAD) has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the “Resilient Irrigation for a Sustainable Economy Project”, and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services. “Consultancy Services to Develop and Deploy the Africa RISE Gateway”

 

  1. Description of Services

The consulting services (“the Services”) include: Task 1: Africa RISE User Requirements Assessment: Map and profile all user groups and partners including relevant African Union agencies and departments (AUDANEPAD, AU-SAFGRAD, SEBE), government ministries, transboundary water management agencies, regulators, MPA focal points, implementing partners, research institutes and universities and technical experts, farmers, aggregators, private sector, equipment suppliers and financial institutions and farmer unions and cooperative societies etc; Task 2: Design, Develop and Commission the Africa RISE Gateway: Define system architecture, data structures, modules, dashboard requirements and proc

ISE User Requirements Assessment: Map and profile all user groups and partners including relevant African Union agencies and departments (AUDANEPAD, AU-SAFGRAD, SEBE), government ministries, transboundary water management agencies, regulators, MPA focal points, implementing partners, research institutes and universities and technical experts, farmers, aggregators, private sector, equipment suppliers and financial institutions and farmer unions and cooperative societies etc; Task 2: Design, Develop and Commission the Africa RISE Gateway: Define system architecture, data structures, modules, dashboard requirements and process workflows, including a unified data interoperability Layer that meets vPIC standards and aligns with the Africa RISE Regional Geospatial Analytics Platform and national irrigation monitoring systems.  The architecture shall specify: (a) the endpoints and payload schemas through which national data collection tools, the Regional Geospatial Platform,  and other authorized external data sources submit and validate benchmarking data; (b) the data lineage and version control mechanisms ensuring that published benchmarks are traceable to their submission source; and (c) the traffic-light alert logic that translates performanc

sociated training materials for all user groups, comprising: (i) a Technical Track for AUDA-NEPAD IT personnel, national technical focal points and system administrators, covering system administration, data management, integration and cybersecurity; (ii) an Operational Track for programme managers, extension officers and policy stakeholders, focusing on effective use of the platform and its functional modules; and (iii) an End-User Track providing simplified guidance and orientation materials. Task 4: Sustainable Operation and Maintenance (O&M) Model for the Gateway: Assess the technical and operational requirements for sustained operation of the Gateway, including hosting, security, data management, updates, user support and maintenance schedules and prepare indicative annual cost projections for the post-project period. Task 5: Envisaged functionality of the Africa RISE Gateway: The Africa RISE Gateway, as a go-to information and knowledge solution, is envisaged to serve.

C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. This service is also extended to eligible American citizens residing abroad. C.3 SCOPE The contractor shall provide the Library with new perpetual RealSAM Dialog licenses and technical support for perpetual RealSAM Dialog licenses—new or legacy— in its possession. This support includes the services needed to operate and maintain NLS’s My Talking Books (an Amazon Alexa skill) in production. My Talking Books is an Alexa skill that enables NLS patrons with Alexa-enabled smart-speaker devices to use a voice-only user interface to search the NLS Catalog, manage their Wishlist, access BARD Lists, and stream audio content from NLS’s Talk

ontractor. Note— These scenarios are mutually exclusive. Consequently, 100% of the Library’s technical support for legacy licenses will be the same. My Talking Books is an Amazon Alexa skill that enables NLS patrons to search the NLS collection, browse the NLS collection, retrieve/manage the patron’s Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Wishlist, stream NLS talking books, and manage the patron’s Bookshelf using a voice-only interface available on Alexa-enabled commercial smart-speaker platforms. The contractor shall be responsible for providing RealSAM Dialog licenses and services required to operate the system in production, while meeting all IT information-system security requirements as required by the Library of Congress. C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. Thi

hall provide the Library with license and technical support. This support shall be provided on an annual basis at a firm-fixed price. This support shall be provided in blocks of 500. The contractor shall provide the Library with a price schedule (Attachment J3 - Pricing Chart.xlsx) for the following scenarios: A. RealSAM Dialog License Support – An annual fee for blocks of 500 perpetual user licenses for the RealSAM dialog engine. BACKGROUND The Department of the Air Force Art Collection is comprised of over 9,000 paintings, works on paper, mixed media, textiles, and sculptures spanning from World War I to the present day. To ensure the long-term preservation and security of a specific portion of this historic collection, the NMUSAF requires temporary, climate- controlled on-site storage for 992 designated artworks at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base (WPAFB). Due to inadequate historical storage conditions at their previous location, all 992 of these specific artworks have experienced prior mold damage. To mitigate risk and contain the issue, all assets will be securely wrapped and packaged in protective materials prior to being placed into the storage containers, preventing any further spread of mold. Maintaining strict, continuous environmental controls within the storage containers is critical to arrest any active mold growth and protect the collection from further deterioration. 2.
